name: San Vicente de Arévalo (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a green triangle issuing from the upper edge to the middle of the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Vicente de Arévalo (a crucified saint, a crow and a millstone on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 3 May 1995 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 135 of 7 June 1995); the flag is a square flag of yellow cloth, gyronny in the height of green, charged at the centre on both faces with the municipal arms.

features.role: triangle from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge
